verses.en: Ta. Sin. Mim
These are verses of the Book that makes (things) clear

verses.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفۡسَكَ اَلَّا يَكُوۡنُوۡا مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers

verses.ar: اِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اٰيَةً فَظَلَّتۡ اَعۡنَاقُهُمۡ لَهَا خٰضِعِيۡنَ
verses.en: If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them from the sky a Sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility

verses.ar: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ
verses.en: But there comes not to them a newly-revealed Message from (Allah) Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom

verses.ar: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوۡا فَسَيَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ اَنۭۡ بٰٓؤُا مَا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
verses.en: They have indeed rejected (the Message): so they will know soon (enough) the truth of what they mocked at

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ كَمۡ اَنۭۡ بَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ زَوۡجٍ كَرِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Do they not look at the earth,- how many noble things of all kinds We have produced therein

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily, thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ نَادٰي رَبُّكَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنِ ائۡتِ الۡقَوۡمَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Behold, thy Lord called Moses: "Go to the people of iniquity
The people of the Pharaoh: will they not fear Allah

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يُّكَذِّبُوۡنِؕ‏
verses.en: He said: "O my Lord! I do fear that they will charge me with falsehood

verses.ar: وَيَضِيۡقُ صَدۡرِيۡ وَلَا يَنۡطَلِقُ لِسَانِيۡ فَاَرۡسِلۡ اِلٰي هٰرُوۡنَ
verses.en: My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (smoothly): so send unto Aaron

verses.ar: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۭۡ بٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّقۡتُلُوۡنِۚۖ‏
verses.en: And (further), they have a charge of crime against me; and I fear they may slay me

verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ فَاذۡهَبَا بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِنَّا مَعَكُمۡ مُّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Allah said: "By no means! proceed then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you, and will listen (to your call)

verses.ar: فَاۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُوۡلَا٘ اِنَّا رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So go forth, both of you, to Pharaoh, and say: 'We have been sent by the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds
Send thou with us the Children of Israel

verses.ar: قَالَ اَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِيۡنَا وَلِيۡدًا وَّلَبِثۡتَ فِيۡنَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: (Pharaoh) said: "Did we not cherish thee as a child among us, and didst thou not stay in our midst many years of thy life

verses.ar: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ الَّتِيۡ فَعَلۡتَ وَاَنۡتَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: And thou didst a deed of thine which (thou knowest) thou didst, and thou art an ungrateful (wretch)

verses.ar: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَا٘ اِذًا وَّاَنَا مِنَ الضَّآلِّيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Moses said: "I did it then, when I was in error

verses.ar: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنۡكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِيۡ رَبِّيۡ حُكۡمًا وَّجَعَلَنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ
verses.en: So I fled from you (all) when I feared you; but my Lord has (since) invested me with judgment (and wisdom) and appointed me as one of the messengers

verses.ar: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ اَنۡ عَبَّدۡتَّ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
verses.en: And this is the favour with which thou dost reproach me,- that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel
Pharaoh said: "And what is the 'Lord and Cherisher of the worlds

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاؕ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّوۡقِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: (Moses) said: "The Lord and Cherisher of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- if ye want to be quite sure
(Pharaoh) said to those around: "Did ye not listen (to what he says)
(Moses) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers from the beginning

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوۡلَكُمُ الَّذِيۡ٘ اُرۡسِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌ
verses.en: (Pharaoh) said: "Truly your messenger who has been sent to you is a veritable madman

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقِ وَالۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاؕ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: (Moses) said: "Lord of the East and the West, and all between! if ye only had sense

verses.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذۡتَ اِلٰهًا غَيۡرِيۡ لَاَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمَسۡجُوۡنِيۡنَ
verses.en: (Pharaoh) said: "If thou dost put forward any god other than me, I will certainly put thee in prison
(Moses) said: "Even if I showed you something clear (and) convincing

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاۡتِ بِهٖ٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: (Pharaoh) said: "Show it then, if thou tellest the truth

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۚۖ‏
verses.en: So (Moses) threw his rod, and behold, it was a serpent, plain (for all to see)

verses.ar: وَّنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders

verses.ar: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَاِ حَوۡلَهٗ٘ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
verses.en: (Pharaoh) said to the Chiefs around him: "This is indeed a sorcerer well-versed

verses.ar: يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّخۡرِجَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِكُمۡ بِسِحۡرِهٖࣗۖ فَمَاذَا تَاۡمُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: His plan is to get you out of your land by his sorcery; then what is it ye counsel

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَرۡجِهۡ وَاَخَاهُ وَابۡعَثۡ فِي الۡمَدَآئِنِ حٰشِرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They said: "Keep him and his brother in suspense (for a while), and dispatch to the Cities heralds to collect
And bring up to thee all (our) sorcerers well-versed
So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known
And the people were told: "Are ye (now) assembled

verses.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا هُمُ الۡغٰلِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: That we may follow the sorcerers (in religion) if they win

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوۡا لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ اَئِنَّ لَنَا لَاَجۡرًا اِنۡ كُنَّا نَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Pharaoh: "Of course - shall we have a (suitable) reward if we win

verses.ar: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَاِنَّكُمۡ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الۡمُقَرَّبِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "Yea, (and more),- for ye shall in that case be (raised to posts) nearest (to my person)

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰ٘ي اَلۡقُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّلۡقُوۡنَ
verses.en: Moses said to them: "Throw ye - that which ye are about to throw

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقَوۡا حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُوۡا بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: So they threw their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the might of Pharaoh, it is we who will certainly win

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقٰي مُوۡسٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَاۡفِكُوۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: Then Moses threw his rod, when, behold, it straightway swallows up all the falsehoods which they fake
Then did the sorcerers fall down, prostrate in adoration
Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the Worlds
The Lord of Moses and Aaron

verses.ar: قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَكُمۡۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيۡرُكُمُ الَّذِيۡ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحۡرَۚ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ࣢ؕ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَكُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Said (Pharaoh): "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? surely he is your leader, who has taught you sorcery! but soon shall ye know! Be sure I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will cause you all to die on the cross

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَا ضَيۡرَؗ اِنَّا٘ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا مُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: They said: "No matter! for us, we shall but return to our Lord

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰيٰنَا٘ اَنۡ كُنَّا٘ اَوَّلَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَࣖؕ‏
verses.en: Only, our desire is that our Lord will forgive us our faults, that we may become foremost among the believers

verses.ar: وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنۡ اَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيۡ٘ اِنَّكُمۡ مُّتَّبَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: By inspiration we told Moses: "Travel by night with my servants; for surely ye shall be pursued
Then Pharaoh sent heralds to (all) the Cities
(Saying): "These (Israelites) are but a small band
And they are raging furiously against us
But we are a multitude amply fore-warned
So We expelled them from gardens, springs
Treasures, and every kind of honourable position
Thus it was, but We made the Children of Israel inheritors of such things
So they pursued them at sunrise

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَ الۡجَمۡعٰنِ قَالَ اَصۡحٰبُ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: And when the two bodies saw each other, the people of Moses said: "We are sure to be overtaken

verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ اِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّيۡ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ
verses.en: (Moses) said: "By no means! my Lord is with me! Soon will He guide me

verses.ar: فَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنِ اضۡرِبۡ بِّعَصَاكَ الۡبَحۡرَؕ فَانۡفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٍ كَالطَّوۡدِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۚ‏
verses.en: Then We told Moses by inspiration: "Strike the sea with thy rod." So it divided, and each separate part became like the huge, firm mass of a mountain
And We made the other party approach thither
We delivered Moses and all who were with him
But We drowned the others

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
And rehearse to them (something of) Abraham's story

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ مَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Behold, he said to his father and his people: "What worship ye

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا نَعۡبُدُ اَصۡنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عٰكِفِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "We worship idols, and we remain constantly in attendance on them
He said: "Do they listen to you when ye call (on them)
Or do you good or harm

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "Nay, but we found our fathers doing thus (what we do)
He said: "Do ye then see whom ye have been worshipping
Ye and your fathers before you

verses.ar: فَاِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوٌّ لِّيۡ٘ اِلَّا رَبَّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: For they are enemies to me; not so the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds
Who created me, and it is He Who guides me
Who gives me food and drink
And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me
Who will cause me to die, and then to life (again)

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡ٘ اَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ لِيۡ خَطِيۡٓـَٔتِيۡ يَوۡمَ الدِّيۡنِؕ‏
verses.en: And who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the day of Judgment

verses.ar: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِيۡ حُكۡمًا وَّاَلۡحِقۡنِيۡ بِالصّٰلِحِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous

verses.ar: وَاجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ فِي الۡاٰخِرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the latest (generations)
Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss

verses.ar: وَاغۡفِرۡ لِاَبِيۡ٘ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Forgive my father, for that he is among those astray
And let me not be in disgrace on the Day when (men) will be raised up

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنۡفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ اَتَي اللّٰهَ بِقَلۡبٍ سَلِيۡمٍؕ‏
verses.en: But only he (will prosper) that brings to Allah a sound heart
To the righteous, the Garden will be brought near
And to those straying in Evil, the Fire will be placed in full view
And it shall be said to them: 'Where are the (gods) ye worshipped

verses.ar: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ هَلۡ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَكُمۡ اَوۡ يَنۡتَصِرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Besides Allah? Can they help you or help themselves
Then they will be thrown headlong into the (Fire),- they and those straying in Evil
And the whole hosts of Iblis together
They will say there in their mutual bickerings

verses.ar: تَاللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنَّا لَفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: By Allah, we were truly in an error manifest
When we held you as equals with the Lord of the Worlds
And our seducers were only those who were steeped in guilt
Now, then, we have none to intercede (for us)
Nor a single friend to feel (for us)

verses.ar: فَلَوۡ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Now if we only had a chance of return we shall truly be of those who believe

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Verily in this is a Sign but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
The people of Noah rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ نُوۡحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Behold, their brother Noah said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds
So fear Allah, and obey me
They said: "Shall we believe in thee when it is the meanest that follow thee

verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِيۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: He said: "And what do I know as to what they do

verses.ar: اِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّيۡ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Their account is only with my Lord, if ye could (but) understand
I am not one to drive away those who believe
I am sent only to warn plainly in public

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ يٰنُوۡحُ لَتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمَرۡجُوۡمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: They said: "If thou desist not, O Noah! thou shalt be stoned (to death)
He said: "O my Lord! truly my people have rejected me

verses.ar: فَافۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحًا وَّنَجِّنِيۡ وَمَنۡ مَّعِيَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Judge Thou, then, between me and them openly, and deliver me and those of the Believers who are with me

verses.ar: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَمَنۡ مَّعَهٗ فِي الۡفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِۚ‏
verses.en: So We delivered him and those with him, in the Ark filled (with all creatures)
Thereafter We drowned those who remained behind

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
The 'Ad (people) rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ هُوۡدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Behold, their brother Hud said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah and obey me

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds
Do ye build a landmark on every high place to amuse yourselves
And do ye get for yourselves fine buildings in the hope of living therein (for ever)
And when ye exert your strong hand, do ye do it like men of absolute power
Now fear Allah, and obey me
Yea, fear Him Who has bestowed on you freely all that ye know
Freely has He bestowed on you cattle and sons
And Gardens and Springs

verses.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍؕ‏
verses.en: Truly I fear for you the Penalty of a Great Day

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَا٘ اَوَعَظۡتَ اَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡوٰعِظِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They said: "It is the same to us whether thou admonish us or be not among (our) admonishers
This is no other than a customary device of the ancients
And we are not the ones to receive Pains and Penalties

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: So they rejected him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
The Thamud (people) rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Behold, their brother Salih said to them: "Will you not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds
Will ye be left secure, in (the enjoyment of) all that ye have here
Gardens and Springs
And corn-fields and date-palms with spathes near breaking (with the weight of fruit)
And ye carve houses out of (rocky) mountains with great skill
But fear Allah and obey me
And follow not the bidding of those who are extravagant

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: Who make mischief in the land, and mend not (their ways)
They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched

verses.ar: مَا٘ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَاۚۖ فَاۡتِ بِاٰيَةٍ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Thou art no more than a mortal like us: then bring us a Sign, if thou tellest the truth

verses.ar: قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرۡبٌ وَّلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍۚ‏
verses.en: He said: "Here is a she-camel: she has a right of watering, and ye have a right of watering, (severally) on a day appointed

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوۡهَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ فَيَاۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Touch her not with harm, lest the Penalty of a Great Day seize you
But they ham-strung her: then did they become full of regrets

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: But the Penalty seized them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
The people of Lut rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ لُوۡطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Behold, their brother Lut said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah and obey me

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the lord of the Worlds
Of all the creatures in the world, will ye approach males

verses.ar: وَتَذَرُوۡنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَزۡوَاجِكُمۡؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عٰدُوۡنَ
verses.en: And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your mates? Nay, ye are a people transgressing (all limits)

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ يٰلُوۡطُ لَتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُخۡرَجِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "If thou desist not, O Lut! thou wilt assuredly be cast out
He said: "I do detest your doings
O my Lord! deliver me and my family from such things as they do
So We delivered him and his family,- all
Except an old woman who lingered behind
But the rest We destroyed utterly

verses.ar: وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّطَرًاۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الۡمُنۡذَرِيۡنَ
verses.en: We rained down on them a shower (of brimstone): and evil was the shower on those who were admonished (but heeded not)

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might Most Merciful
The Companions of the Wood rejected the messengers

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Behold, Shu'aib said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah and obey me

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds

verses.ar: اَوۡفُوا الۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُخۡسِرِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Give just measure, and cause no loss (to others by fraud)
And weigh with scales true and upright

verses.ar: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: And withhold not things justly due to men, nor do evil in the land, working mischief
And fear Him Who created you and (who created) the generations before (you)
They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَا وَاِنۡ نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Thou art no more than a mortal like us, and indeed we think thou art a liar

verses.ar: فَاَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Now cause a piece of the sky to fall on us, if thou art truthful
He said: "My Lord knows best what ye do

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ الظُّلَّةِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
verses.en: But they rejected him. Then the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom seized them, and that was the Penalty of a Great Day

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Verily in that is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds
With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth
To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish
In the perspicuous Arabic tongue
Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهُمۡ اٰيَةً اَنۡ يَّعۡلَمَهٗ عُلَمٰٓؤُا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
verses.en: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)
Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs

verses.ar: فَقَرَاَهٗ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it
Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners

verses.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ حَتّٰي يَرَوُا الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِيۡمَۙ‏
verses.en: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty
But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not
Then they will say: "Shall we be respited
Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on
Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years
Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised

verses.ar: مَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يُمَتَّعُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنۡذِرُوۡنَࣗۖۛ‏
verses.en: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners
By way of reminder; and We never are unjust
No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation)

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لَهُمۡ وَمَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it)
Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it

verses.ar: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُعَذَّبِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty
And admonish thy nearest kinsmen

verses.ar: وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ اِنِّيۡ بَرِيۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do
And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer)
And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves
For it is He Who heareth and knoweth all things

verses.ar: هَلۡ اُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلٰي مَنۡ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰطِيۡنُؕ‏
verses.en: Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend
They descend on every lying, wicked person
(Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars
And the Poets,- It is those straying in Evil, who follow them

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّهُمۡ فِيۡ كُلِّ وَادٍ يَّهِيۡمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Seest thou not that they wander distracted in every valley
And that they say what they practise not

verses.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيۡرًا وَّانۡتَصَرُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُوۡاؕ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَيَّ مُنۡقَلَبٍ يَّنۡقَلِبُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Except those who believe, work righteousness, engage much in the remembrance of Allah, and defend themselves only after they are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust assailants know what vicissitudes their affairs will take
